cohort: The study included breeding non-human primates (baboons, cynomolgus macaques, and rhesus macaques) from large colonies at the Southwest National Primate Research Center.
finding: Retained placenta occurred in 2.7% of baboons, 3.3% of cynomolgus macaques, and 1.0% of rhesus macaques, with stillbirth/abortion and prior cesarean section identified as risk factors.
mod_finding: Prior cesarean section was identified as an incidence factor for retained placenta in baboons and cynomolgus macaques.
